description: A deliberately misspecified case for the PyMC one-chain adapter (WP-H71a). Extreme data ([100, 101]) fit with a tight prior (mu_prior_sigma=0.01, sigma_prior=0.01) under a low target_accept (0.3) produces a hard posterior geometry: divergences occur and/or ess drops below the adapter ESS floor, so the result carries diagnostics_flag=warn. This is honest: a single chain cannot certify convergence, and the diagnostics surface the pathology rather than hiding it. The case is stable across seeds (diagnostics_flag=warn for every seed tested).

expected.diagnostics_flag_rationale: At least one of: divergences > 0, or ess_min below the ESS_FLOOR (50). A single chain cannot compute r_hat, so rhat_max is None and cannot trip the flag.
